section_summary.extract_value: This section reviews cross-sectional and experimental research on the relationship between gratitude and physical health. It highlights findings that gratitude is negatively associated with somatic symptoms, buffers against stress, enhances physical health behaviors like sleep quality, and is related to lower inflammatory biomarkers. The section discusses various studies, including those by Hill et al., Froh et al., Krause, Wood et al., Ng and Wong, Mills et al., Jackowska et al., and Emmons and McCullough, noting promising but sometimes inconsistent results, particularly in experimental settings.
